verdict.rationale: Version history is a fair question for a document-management platform, so the axis applies. The pack documents only general file CRUD over REST, read-write driveItems in Graph, and a Recycle operation for deleted objects. None of it covers listing or restoring file revisions, or retention windows for versions. The recycle-bin behavior is an adjacent deletion feature, not version history, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, version history is addressable — file revisions can be listed and restored via the API, with documented retention windows
